Privacy Policy

How we collect, use and protect your information.

Last updated: November 2026

Information we collect

When you fill in a form on our website we collect the details you provide, such as your name, company, work email, phone number and message.

Our customers' HR data processed in the SublimeHR platform is handled under the agreement with each customer.

How we use information

  • To respond to demo, quote and sales requests
  • To provide, support and improve our services
  • To send service-related communication you have asked for

Data security

We use secure cloud infrastructure, encrypted connections, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication and tenant isolation to protect data.

Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us operate our services, or where required by law.

Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us.
